svg.desc: Five acquisitions at one frequency supply readings from many input edges. Each edge is assigned time zero and its voltages normalized. All points are pooled, a curve fitted near fifty percent, and one crossing time calculated. Illustrative points, not measured data.
svg.text: One frequency; rising edges only. Falling edges were analyzed separately. Illustrative points.
Combine the readings, retaining each point's time and voltage fraction
Time zero = its own GPIO6 edge. Starting level = 0%; final level = 100%.
Combined points from all five acquisitions
The readings were combined before fitting; five separately calculated delays were not averaged.
